turns: Show each order ID with the name of the customer who placed it.
reference_sql: SELECT o.id, c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id

turns: Which product categories appear in more than 8 orders?
reference_sql: SELECT p.category FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) > 8

turns: How many orders were placed each month in 2024?
reference_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024' GROUP BY month

turns: What are the top 3 products by units sold?
reference_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 3

turns: What percentage of total revenue does each customer account for?
reference_sql: WITH s AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS spend FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT c.name, 100.0 * s.spend / (SELECT SUM(spend) FROM s) FROM s JOIN customers c ON c.id = s.customer_id
